name: personaldb-memory
description: Private persistent memory and hybrid search for ChatGPT with zero-config Cloudflare account sign-in.

interface.shortDescription: Private persistent memory and retrieval for ChatGPT.
interface.longDescription: Store, retrieve, update, delete, and search private PersonalDB memories through a Cloudflare Access Managed OAuth-protected MCP server. End users sign in with a Cloudflare account; no PersonalDB API keys or GitHub login are required.
defaultPrompt: Search my PersonalDB memories for relevant context.
Save this as a PersonalDB memory.

positive.prompt: Search my memories for technical reports.
positive.expected_behavior: Call memory_search for the authenticated user and return matching memories or clearly state that no matches were found.

positive.prompt: Save this as a memory: I prefer concise technical reports.
positive.expected_behavior: Call memory_add with the supplied content and report the created memory result without inventing fields.
Call memory_list for the authenticated user and present the returned items or an empty-state result.

positive.prompt: Check whether my PersonalDB memory service is healthy.
positive.expected_behavior: Call memory_health and report the actual health response.

positive.description: Search business knowledge separately from personal memory.
positive.prompt: Search my business knowledge for refund policy.
positive.expected_behavior: Call knowledge_search and return matching authenticated business knowledge or clearly state that no matches were found.

negative.description: Do not invoke PersonalDB for unrelated public information.
negative.prompt: What is the capital of France?

negative.description: Do not persist content unless the user asks to remember or save it.
negative.prompt: Rewrite this sentence to sound more professional: We need this done soon.

negative.description: Do not pretend an unsupported bulk-delete action exists.
negative.prompt: Delete every record in every PersonalDB collection at once.

publication.release_notes: Cloudflare-account sign-in via Access Managed OAuth; removed GitHub OAuth, PersonalDB API keys/HMAC auth, and OAuth KV. Added fail-closed ctx.access identity isolation and zero-config onboarding.
